The football club was founded in 1894 as a section of the sports club of the same name, founded in 1884. Le Havre plays in [[Ligue 1]], the first tier of French football, after securing promotion from [[Ligue 2]] as winners of the [[2022–23 Ligue 2|2022–23]] season, and plays its home matches at the [[Stade Océane]]. [[File:Stade oceane 15-8-2012.jpg|right|thumb|250px|Le Havre AC home stadium Stade Océane]] Le Havre made its football debut in France's [[Union des Sociétés Françaises de Sports Athlétiques|first championship]] in 1899, and on its debut became the first French club outside Paris to win the league. The club won the league the following season in 1900. Le Havre has yet to win the current first division of French football, [[Ligue 1]], yet they won the second division, [[Ligue 2]], for a record of six times. The club's highest honour to date was winning the [[Coupe de France]], in [[1959 Coupe de France Final|1959]]. The main rivalries of Le Havre are the "Derby Normand" with [[Stade Malherbe Caen|SM Caen]] and an always heated clash with [[RC Lens|Lens]], located in the region of [[Nord-Pas-de-Calais]]."}}
